'''Lees Brannin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], she was stationed at the [[Forward Bunker]] on the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], distributing [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and medical supplies to other Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lees appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Stims Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" /> The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released alongside the game, identified her as Lees Brannin.
